assets.name: experience
assets.prompt: One original mobile sci-fi flight game INVENTORY EXPERIENCE RESOURCE icon. A compact chunky blue-white navy beveled hexagonal training-data medallion, luminous cyan rising double chevrons on face and small integrated clear letters EXP. Polished flat cartoon hard-surface graphic, thick dark navy contour, 2 to 3 flat shading levels, clean big shapes, no tiny mechanical detail. White steel outer rim, teal glass center. Single isolated object fills 80% canvas with transparent margin. Not a weapon, not a coin, not a talent card. No background, no card frame, no watermark. Transparent background. Original design.

assets.name: basic-ticket
assets.prompt: One original mobile sci-fi flight game BASIC EQUIPMENT CRATE VOUCHER inventory icon. Single wide horizontal silver-white and blue-grey hard-surface futuristic ticket, chamfered ends and one square notch each short edge. Large simple small white-blue cargo crate emblem at center, navy outline, one cyan stripe. Flat cartoon game icon, bold dark navy contour, 2 to 3 flat shading levels, clear shapes, only minimal sci-fi panel seams, no microdetails. This is a ticket not a box itself. Slight perspective, fills 80% canvas with transparent margins, no letters or text or numbers. Transparent background, no framing card, no watermark. Original design.

Flat cartoon game icon, bold dark navy contour, 2 to 3 flat shading levels, clear shapes, only minimal sci-fi panel seams, no microdetails. This is a ticket not a box itself. Slight perspective, fills 80% canvas with transparent margins, no letters or text or numbers. Transparent background, no framing card, no watermark. Original design.
